# Run Migrations Offline

This feature allows the application to perform database migrations in offline mode. It configures the migration context with the database URL and target metadata and executes the migration transactions without a live database connection.

**Anchored to:**

- `alembic/env.py` — `alembic.env.run_migrations_offline`
